# Fetch pending received payment requests and approve those from roommates/coworkers
venmo_pw = [x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='venmo'][0]
venmo_login = apis.venmo.login(username='nan_ritt@gmail.com', password=venmo_pw)
access_token = venmo_login['access_token']

# emails set from prior contact search (roommate/coworker)
# (reconstruct to ensure available in this execution scope)
phone_pw = [x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='phone'][0]
phone_login = apis.phone.login(username='2307354647', password=phone_pw)
phone_access_token = phone_login['access_token']

emails = set()
for rel in ['roommate','coworker']:
    i=0
    while True:
        res = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_access_token, query='', relationship=rel, page_index=i, page_limit=20)
        if not res:
            break
        for c in res:
            if c.get('email'):
                emails.add(c['email'].strip().lower())
        i += 1

print('roommate/coworker emails:', len(emails))

pending_requests = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(access_token=access_token, status='pending', page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    print('page', page_index, 'len', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    pending_requests.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

print('total pending requests:', len(pending_requests))

# Filter approvals based on sender email
approvable = []
for pr in pending_requests:
    sender_email = (pr.get('sender', {}) or {}).get('email')
    if sender_email and sender_email.strip().lower() in emails:
        approvable.append(pr)

print('approvable pending requests:', len(approvable))
print('approvable ids:', [pr['payment_request_id'] for pr in approvable])
print('approvable senders:', [(pr.get('sender',{}).get('name'), pr.get('sender',{}).get('email'), pr.get('amount')) for pr in approvable])

# Approve each
results = []
for pr in approvable:
    pr_id = pr['payment_request_id']
    resp = apis.venmo.approve_payment_request(payment_request_id=pr_id, access_token=access_token)
    results.append((pr_id, resp))

print('approval results count:', len(results))
print(results)
